representation_signature.decimal_orbits: one nontrivial reversal pair plus one four-digit palindrome plus one five-digit palindrome

N1_REPRESENTATION_MATCHED.constraint: one distinct four-digit reversal pair, one distinct odd four-digit palindrome and one distinct odd five-digit palindrome in [10000,19999]
N1_REPRESENTATION_MATCHED.purpose: hold the visible decimal-orbit structure fixed while testing independent arithmetic coherence

N2_FACTOR_SCALE_MATCHED.constraint: for each target slot: same decimal digit length, same omega, same Omega and value within plus-or-minus 20 percent; target values excluded
N2_FACTOR_SCALE_MATCHED.purpose: hold scale and factor-count profile fixed without enforcing decimal reversal closure

decision.primary_pass: lower-tail empirical p<=0.01 under both N1 and N2
decision.robust_pass: primary pass plus p<=0.05 under both nulls for every leave-one-block-out score

claim_boundary: Post-hoc calibration of one owner-selected quartet under two declared nulls. No natural geometry, NCS mechanism, universal CRT/QRT operator, physical resonance or discovery claim follows.
